method: The current method stands: one pass over the stage-2 plane inliers from that same estimate. Width is max(x) minus min(x), height is max(y) minus min(y), and depth is the arithmetic mean range of those inliers, in metres. Copy those three values onto the same /pps/pallet_pose_rich PalletPoseStamped as the pose, and only when that estimate produced them. A stored 1.20 m by 0.14 m prototype, a template or CAD face, an object-frame cuboid, a covariance or minimum-volume box, rotating calipers, an interquartile or percentile span, and a second topic each measure a different size or add another hop, so none replaces this reduction.
